note: Reviewed differences between this SDK's OpenAPI document and the Medal API's published one, checked by scripts/assert-openapi-sdk-coverage.mjs. Every entry needs a reason naming the evidence. An entry that stops matching anything FAILS the gate, so this file cannot decay into a blanket waiver.

no_client_method.reason: A public browser navigation, not an API call: Vipps redirects the customer here with no API key and Medal answers a 302 back to the site's return_url. Documented so integrators can read the flow; there is nothing for an SDK method to do.

enum_locations.reason: The API's published document is behind its implementation: ATTENTION_KINDS in apps/convex/bookings/attention.ts includes payment_partial_capture, which the feed really emits (attention.ts:412). The SDK encodes the implementation; the document needs the value added on the API side.

The API's published document is behind its implementation: the helpdesk channel literals in apps/convex/schema/helpdesk.ts include telegram, which is the whole point of the Telegram inbox connector. The SDK encodes the implementation.
Same stale channel list as the collection route above — telegram is a real conversation channel in apps/convex/schema/helpdesk.ts.

The API's document declares a field its own schema does not accept: importContactItemSchema (apps/convex/api/v1/types.ts) takes email, names, phone, company, job_title, label_ids and status only, so sending email_status is a 400. The SDK matches the schema.

The list route accepts BOTH platform and platforms (apps/convex/api/v1/posts.ts merges parseQueryParamArray for each). The SDK sends the plural, array-friendly form and documents only that; the singular stays an undocumented alias.
The API's document describes a full contact in the create response; the handler answers { data: { id } } only (apps/convex/api/v1/contacts.ts:119). The SDK matches the handler.
Same stale create-response shape: the handler returns only the new contact's id.
The API's document describes a full contact in the update response; the handler answers { data: { success: true } } (apps/convex/api/v1/contacts.ts:183). The SDK matches the handler.
Same stale update-response shape: the handler returns only { success: true }.
The API's document wraps the consent list in data.consents; the handler answers data as the ARRAY itself (apps/convex/api/v1/gdpr.ts:164-176). The SDK matches the handler.
